info.name: Azure Monitor Alerts API
info.description:
Create, update, and manage classic metric alert rules for monitoring Azure resources. Supports threshold-based alerts on resource metrics with configurable conditions and actions.

Contact Support:
 Name: Microsoft Azure Support

item.name: Azure Monitor Create or update a classic metric alert rule

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the target subscription.
(Required) The name of the resource group.

request.description: Creates or updates a classic metric alert rule. Classic alert rules evaluate metrics at regular intervals and trigger actions when conditions are met.

response.name: Successful request to update an alert rule.
